passCriteria: A and B: approved lambda-calibrated no-edge bounds; C: planted card >=8/10, planted gross within ±0.05R of pilot gross, non-planted/non-excluded confirmations <=0.5/world; C-D report-only/no criterion

lambdaModel.source: A-only, 10 diagnostic worlds × 44 strategy-level card-half cells; average each cell's pConfirmedUpperBound over A worlds, combine each card's two halves by union probability, sum 22 card probabilities

preRegistration.realDevFeatureScope: Map/features/signals recomputed independently within four DEV segments; no VAL/HOLDOUT/STRESS OHLC was passed to Map or signal code; no real DEV trades or outcomes were generated in Part 2.
preRegistration.segmentRule: four contiguous DEV segments 2004-2007, 2009-2011, 2013-2015, 2017-2018; reset features at each segment boundary; entry warm-up 1,000 bars and 96-bar tail
preRegistration.scoredSeedPolicy: new Stage 3b seeds start at 20261201; disjoint from all three pilot seeds and prior Stage 3a seeds

candidateRules.selection: highest real-DEV exclusive share among eligible cards; deterministic cardId tie-break

conditionBCalibration.sameScoringPath: Three disjoint 60k pilot seeds; world-specific M15 seed+71; exact DEV pipeline; random long candidates remapped to center Map state and UNKNOWN dropped before matched baseline; drift remains a constant per-bar additive return.

contamination.calculation: pairwise same-bar/same-side co-fire count / planted card's real DEV signal count; determined from signals only before any scored outcomes
